final_candidates.decision_summary: T318I enhances hydrophobic core packing within the HA stem near the fusion peptide, consistently increasing thermal and environmental stability.
K387I strengthens hydrophobic coiled-coil packing at the HA2 stem trimer interface to promote overall folding stability.
D441N alleviates unfavorable local electrostatic repulsion in the stalk region while preserving critical hydrogen-bonding capacity.

stop_reason.detail: Optimal Top-3 mutations identified and validated without requiring additional iterative rounds.

history.rationale: T318 is located at the HA1 prefusion stem interface near the fusion peptide pocket; substitution with isoleucine optimizes hydrophobic packing, stabilizing the prefusion trimer and improving environmental persistence.
T318I enhances hydrophobic core packing in the HA stem region near the fusion peptide, providing well-documented gains in thermal stability.
Position 387 (HA2 position 58) resides in the stalk coiled-coil core; mutating lysine to isoleucine enhances core hydrophobic packing and raises thermal unfolding resistance.
Substituting the exposed/interfacial Lys with Ile reinforces hydrophobic interactions along the central coiled-coil stem of HA2.
D441 (HA2 position 112) is involved in protonation-triggered conformational rearrangement; the D441N substitution neutralizes an acidic trigger residue, stabilizing the prefusion ground state.
D441N mitigates unfavorable electrostatic repulsion at the trimer stem interface while preserving hydrogen-bonding capacity.
Valine at position 318 similarly improves hydrophobic contact at the inter-subunit interface while maintaining steric tolerance relative to wild-type threonine.
T318V is structurally redundant and provides less steric packing volume than the superior T318I substitution.

rejection.reason: T318V is structurally redundant and provides less steric packing volume than the superior T318I substitution.

history.rationale: S219 is positioned at the head domain inter-protomer interface where aromatic substitution introduces favorable quaternary van der Waals and pi-stacking interactions.
S219Y introduces stabilizing aromatic packing at the HA head domain interface without compromising receptor-binding pocket geometry.
Alanine replacement removes the negative charge at D441, preventing destabilizing electrostatic repulsion during low pH / thermal stress in the coiled-coil region.
D441A removes negative charge but sacrifices polar sidechain contacts that D441N effectively preserves.

rejection.reason: D441A removes negative charge but sacrifices polar sidechain contacts that D441N effectively preserves.

history.rationale: Methionine at position 387 provides an uncharged, hydrophobic side chain that packs effectively within the stalk helical bundle without causing steric clashes.
K387M provides moderate hydrophobic stabilization at position 387 but is structurally less favorable than beta-branched Ile.
H393 serves as a pH-sensing histidine in the stalk; replacing it with tyrosine eliminates premature protonation-induced conformational instability.
H393Y improves local packing and raises resistance to premature low-pH conformational changes in the stem.
